external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor node installed on a customer site that publishes readings and polls for firmware updates.
external_entities.source_excerpt: a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside our physical control, and a technician can be standing next to one with a laptop.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes over a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker running on GKE that accepts sensor readings and checks devices against the device registry.
processes.source_excerpt: the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: The gateway uses a per-fleet pre-shared key for node authentication. Nobody has rotated the key since deployment.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer in the analytics network that consumes readings and writes them to the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

processes.name: dashboard
processes.description: A dashboard used by fleet operators to view telemetry over BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry containing device information used to check keys and determine customer ownership.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service onto which accepted readings are forwarded for consumption by the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing sensor readings, site addresses, and occupancy patterns, which is customer data.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: firmware bucket
data_stores.description: A Cloud Storage bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not establish whether nodes check a signature before installing an image.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway over MQTT.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up a device in the device registry to check the key and determine the customer association.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: The device gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the firmware bucket for a new image and installs what it finds.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image and install what they find.
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read. The source does not establish whether the nodes check a signature on the image before installing it.

data_flows.name: service console
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over a local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: The source says: "I don't know what authentication that console has, if any."

data_flows.name: view dashboards
data_flows.description: A fleet operator views dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

data_flows.name: read telemetry
data_flows.description: The dashboard accesses telemetry in BigQuery for fleet operators.
data_flows.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-controlled site where sensor nodes are installed.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites
trust_boundaries.notes: The nodes are outside our physical control.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The public network from which sensor nodes connect to the device gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: expose to the internet because the nodes dial in from anywhere

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the telemetry normalizer.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators access dashboards.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The source says the lake contains site addresses and occupancy patterns and describes them as customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The registry contains device keys and information about which customer each node belongs to.
